slides.headline: You spend your nights together
slides.body: and talk until sunrise. Yet when you ask where this is going, he smiles: "Why ruin it with labels?"
slides.animal_job: intuition: cat detects hidden avoidance beneath sweet and tender words

slides.headline: Wifey loyalty on zero terms
slides.body: You give devotion and emotional care, yet feel terrified to ask "what are we?" without seeming needy.
slides.animal_job: loyalty to unanswered questions: waiting by the door for a choice

slides.headline: The cool girl trap
slides.body: You hold back your needs. You hope that if you ask for nothing, he will appreciate your patience and commit.

slides.headline: The 100/0 Situationship contract
slides.body: He gets 100% of relationship perks with 0% accountability. "No labels" is simply an easy exit clause.
slides.animal_job: clarity: owl pierces through romantic fog into underlying motives

slides.headline: Committed vs The Grey Zone
lines: Committed: clear status, shared future, emotional safety
Grey Zone: terms on his schedule, plans for tonight, anxiety
slides.body: Committed: clear status, plans for months ahead, safety. Grey Zone: terms on his schedule and constant anxiety.

slides.headline: Says vs Hears vs Reality
lines: Says: "Why ruin a great vibe with heavy labels?"
You hear: "He values pure, organic connection"
Reality: "I want full access without being accountable"
slides.body: Says: "Why ruin the vibe." You hear: "He loves spontaneity." Reality: desires full intimacy without responsibility.

slides.headline: 3 clarity tests to know where you stand
lines: 1. Public test: does his inner circle know you are a couple?
2. Support test: is he present on a messy Tuesday afternoon?
3. Direct test: does asking about status trigger defensive anger?
slides.body: 1. Public test: does his circle know you? 2. Support test: is he there on messy weekdays? 3. Direct test: does asking trigger anger?

slides.headline: Clarity is the bare minimum
slides.body: A man who avoids calling you his is keeping the exit door unlocked. Your heart is not an audition room.
